sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can talk about my travel plans and say how long I'm going somewhere for.
I can ask when and from where a train departs and arrives, and how far a ticket is valid.
I can name key things at an airport and say what you have to do to get through it.
I can describe a travel problem and say what happens if something goes wrong.
I can say what I like and hate about traveling and give a reason why.
